parsedVerdict.reasoning:
This unit passes. All three files cover one concern: shared domain value objects, each built on the @nestjslatam/ddd-lib base classes. Name and Description extend StringValueObject, and Price extends NumberValueObject. All three use the module's abstractions the same way. Each has a validating static create() that throws BrokenRulesException when isValid is false, and a non-validating static load() for rehydration. Each registers its rules in addValidators() using a dedicated validator from ./validators. Each rule lives in one place: name length in NameLengthValidator, description length in DescriptionLengthValidator, and price range in PriceRangeValidator, with the generic number checks taken from the library. No file bypasses these abstractions or duplicates another file's invariant.

The create() check-and-throw block is repeated in all three classes. It could be moved into a shared base helper, but it is a repeated factory pattern, not a duplicated domain rule, so it does not meet the rubric's fail condition. The mixed file-name casing (Name.ts vs description.ts) is cosmetic and outside this rule.
